meta.title: Memory Recall
meta.description: Archives the earliest conversation context into memory/ folders as *pending* entries (no model call during archiving; since v1.4.1 every archive brings the context below compress.releaseTargetPercent); the next request's system prompt gets a memory-scoring task section and the current session model submits α, trust β, keywords and an optional event label through the memory_judge tool in its own context — unscored memories are not recalled. Later matching memories are recalled by keyword (including bidirectional matching) with α as a deterministic priority (FAIR-DRI fair lanes: a query-matched high-α memory surfaces in the same round, low-α memories get a bounded worst-case latency and are never discarded) plus optional time / event constraints, with a per-memory β usage preamble; when the context exceeds the threshold again the oldest recalled entries are removed from the injected block and marked for re-review (no new folders are created). Restarts restore a recall-state v3 snapshot of the recalled block. Disabling the plugin row unregisters the tools, the prompt sections and every listener; config.json enabled=false is an activation-time switch (reloading the plugin is required to re-enable it). Since v1.3.0 it also supports two QQ channels (dsh-onebot-qq and Derpyu520/qq-bridge): automatic detection, one memory folder per stable chat key, an α floor for recalls triggered by non-owner group members, a reversible auto-patch of the Derpyu tool whitelist and a heuristic-scoring fallback. Since v1.4.2 a memory_group_recall tool lets a QQ private-chat owner query group-chat memories read-only (private→group only; group chats, non-owners, WebUI and subagents are rejected; private/WebUI memories are never returned; the owner identity is checked against compat.ownerIds and the tool is fail-closed when it is empty). Since v1.4.3 the scoring summary, the re-review body and the group-chat snippets render archived QQ tool-result JSON as readable sender：text conversation lines instead of raw field names.
